creator: Ad Meskens
alt: The White House’s south facade viewed from the Washington Monument; architectural context, not a current event.
description: South facade of the White House, Washington DC, as seen from the Washington Monument. The White House is the official residence and principal workplace of the President of the United States. Located at 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW in Washington, D.C., it was built between 1792 and 1800 of white-painted Aquia sandstone in the late Georgian style and has been the executive residence of every U.S. President since John Adams.
caption: The White House’s south facade viewed from the Washington Monument; architectural context, not a current event.
